verdict.rationale: Mistral's OCR API documents dedicated header and footer extraction into separate fields, and blocks with structural labels returned in reading order. It also claims strong handling of advanced layouts, and an early tester praised its PDF-to-markdown output. One hands-on tester, though, saw a whole page returned as a single image instead of text. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of footnote handling, explicit multi-column layout handling, and independent benchmarks of reading-order accuracy on complex real-world PDFs.

support.subject: As a developer, the API parses complex real-world PDFs — multi-column layouts, headers, footers, footnotes — into clean, correctly ordered content

citations.quote: When you use them, the response includes header and footer content in the `header` and `footer` fields.
each page contains a `blocks` array with paragraph-level bounding boxes, structural block labels, and extracted content in reading order.
Mistral OCR excels in understanding complex document elements, including interleaved imagery, mathematical expressions, tables, and advanced layouts such as LaTeX
